title: Extra Enchants
body:
![ICON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9064dac78acbe8b16c7f6b2b5de0e028123bae73.png)
# EXTRA ENCHANTS
This mod adds 6 new vanilla-friendly enchantments

It adds 0 new assets, so this mod can be installed on a server without the players having to install it on their client.

## Enchantments
<details>
<summary>Vein-Miner</summary>
When put on a pickaxe, mines an entire ore vein after breaking one ore, but consumes twice the normal durability. Mutually exclusive with silk-touch.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Timber</summary>
When put on an axe, mines an entire tree vein after breaking one log, but consumes twice the normal durability. Mutually exclusive with silk-touch.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Reach</summary>
When put on any tool, grants extra attack and block interaction range. (+1 block and +0.75 attack each level)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mirror</summary>
When put on a shield, counters attacks when shield is up, 50% of the damage is redirected. (Cooldown decreases by 0.5 seconds each level)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Siphoning</summary>
When put on a weapon, heals you by 10% of the damage you dealt + the enchantment level. (1 = 15, 4 = 30) Mutually exclusive with fire aspect.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Amplify</summary>
When put on a weapon, mobs drop extra XP on death. (max of 2x)
</details>


## Compatability
This has compatability with [JEI Enchantment Info](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei-enchantment-info) and [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions)
